{"consolidated_memory":"LATENCY SPIKE ISSUES IN ml/serving/batcher.py - FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Component: ml/serving/batcher.py (ml pipeline side)
Common symptom across all incidents: tail far above the median in the serving histogram
Common repro method: send the mixed-size request trace

---

INCIDENT 1 [2026-04-01]
Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
PR: #3194, branch: fix/latency-spike-1
Result: 56 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

---

INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-16]
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Affected: clients pinned to the v1 SDK
Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
PR: #3536, branch: fix/latency-spike-2
Result: job finished in 43 minutes instead of 3 hours

---

INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-03]
Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
Affected: traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR: #7068, branch: fix/latency-spike-3
Tech stack: Python, covering check is tests/ml/test_batcher.py
Result: reclaimed 19 GB of blob storage

---

INCIDENT 4 [2026-08-28]
Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
Affected: after rolling restart of the fleet
Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR: #9500, branch: fix/latency-spike-4
Result: p99 latency fell from 2.7 s to 418 ms"}
